last_scene.summary: After teasing the audience with a dangerous song about power and postponing it to a possible larger concert, Arlequino asked whether he should choose the next song himself. The crowd broadly agreed. He then performed 'Я вам не верю', identifying it by reference to Grigory Leps's 'Я тебе не верю'. Because the user supplied only the title/reference and not exact lyrics, reactions were based only on the recognizable overall character of the number: emotionally forceful distrust, accusation, wounded pride and a strong dramatic refrain, with no invented lyric quotations. The change from cemetery black comedy to a direct relationship song landed well. Some civilians and women in the crowd reacted strongly to the emotional tension; younger fighters initially joked about whether the title was aimed at the audience, then quieted once the performance committed to the dramatic tone; the healer woman watched with amused suspicion after the earlier bait-and-switch songs; the enchanter man joked that at least nobody was being transformed this time. The refrain drew clapping and some attempts to join the recognizable hook without any canonical quoted lines. Tips +24s12c; expenses 0; net +24s12c. Personal cash became 22g91s96c.
